verdict.rationale: The service's own Business page says founders can 'File Your Wyoming LLC, Profit, Nonprofit, or Limited Partnership Online Now!', and the Annual Report Wizard files annual reports electronically. A probe confirms the WyoBiz portal is live, with filings, annual reports and registered-agent changes handled through an authenticated account. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that fees can be paid online, and hands-on evidence of a formation filing completed end-to-end.
